theme_central: Affirmation of the resurrection, illustrated by Pharaoh who dared say "I am your lord, the Most High" and was exemplarily punished.

branches.title: Oaths by the angels
branches.resume: Oaths by the angels who wrest out souls, violently or gently, who race ahead and administer affairs.

children.t: Oaths by the angels who wrest out souls and administer affairs

branches.title: Skepticism about the resurrection
branches.resume: "Will we be returned to our former state after becoming decayed bones?" A single Cry will suffice.

children.t: Skepticism about the resurrection, a single Cry will suffice

branches.title: Musa and Pharaoh
branches.resume: Musa sent to Pharaoh, call to purification; Pharaoh proclaims "I am your lord", exemplary punishment.

children.t: Musa sent to Pharaoh, call to purification and reverent fear
Pharaoh denies despite the great sign, exemplary punishment

branches.title: Allah's creation
branches.resume: Are you harder to create than the sky? The earth spread out, water and pastures, mountains firmly set.

children.t: Creation of the sky, the earth, water and the mountains

branches.title: The Day of Judgment
branches.resume: The great catastrophe, man remembers his efforts, Hell and Paradise for whoever feared his Lord.

children.t: The great catastrophe, Hell and Paradise according to fear of Allah

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Question about the timing of the Hour, knowledge reserved for Allah, perceived brevity of earthly life.

children.t: Timing of the Hour reserved for Allah, brevity of earthly life
